headline: Optimizely supply chain malware reached CNN, Fox News, BBC and Salesforce sites; Uber and Legoland breaches; PHP2Shell hits Check Point

bullets.text: New: BleepingComputer reports the Optimizely supply chain attack delivered malware to sites including CNN, Fox News, BBC and Salesforce. No CVE, affected versions or fix are given yet.
Still active: Legoland customer personal information has leaked, including annual pass barcodes, per DataBreaches.net. No details on scope or cause are given yet.
Still active: Uber says nearly 150,000 people were impacted by a third-party breach (The Record); TechCrunch reports hackers stole driver's license information.
Still active: Microsoft warns of a high-volume phishing campaign that uses Microsoft 365 outage lures against organizations across multiple sectors.

Still active, critical: a PHP2Shell flaw is exploited in chained attacks on unpatched Check Point gateways (no CVE given). Check Point CVE-2026-123039 and exploited UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 passed their KEV deadline on 11-16.

Context: Infoblox data was exposed via SharePoint and Barracuda links its cloud breach to ARTEX. SITCON 3 unchanged; 7-day score is 0.72x the 90-day average; n0n (78) and INC Ransom (53) lead leak-site claims.

actions: Optimizely users: audit third-party scripts and Optimizely snippets on your sites for unexpected changes, and follow Optimizely's guidance as it is published.
Expect breach-themed phishing after the Uber and Legoland leaks; verify any breach notice through the company's official channels before acting on it.
Warn staff that Microsoft 365 outage notices may be phishing; check the official service health page and report outage-themed lures.
Check Point gateways: apply all current fixes including CVE-2026-123039, restrict management access and hunt for PHP2Shell chained compromise.
Barracuda customers: patch CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 now and review cloud account access.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 due 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
